action: Wet-clean dust; avoid disturbing suspected old lead paint; use lead-safe certified professionals; discuss risk-based testing.
cost: Usually low routine cost; professional testing/remediation can be costly
caution: Do not sand suspected lead paint or use unreviewed detox products.

action: Check utility report and local alerts; private well lab test; use certified contaminant-specific filtration or verified safe source.
caution: Boiling does not remove lead, nitrate or PFAS. No single filter removes everything; do not use unsafe water for formula.

action: Keep home and car smoke-free; support quitting and avoid secondhand exposure.
caution: No shame, no unsupervised abrupt discontinuation of prescribed meds; seek professional support.

action: Use FDA/EPA lower-mercury choices and local fish advisories.
caution: Do not eliminate all fish due to mercury fears; age-specific guidance.

action: Ask occupational health about safer duties and controls; change shoes/clothes before bringing contamination home; employer laundering when appropriate.
cost: Often low household cost; employer controls
caution: Do not rely on PPE alone or provide job clearance.

action: Use outdoor air alerts, source control, appropriate ventilation when outdoor air is safe, properly sized particle filter if needed.
cost: Free alerts; filter purchase and maintenance vary
caution: Avoid ozone generators; heat safety still matters; no purifier guarantee of fetal benefit.

action: Plan cooler activities, shade, water and cooling breaks; avoid hot cars.
cost: Low routine cost, cooling access varies
caution: No infant extra water prescription or fixed heat threshold; symptoms need care.

action: Use existing food-safe glass or stainless for suitable storage/heating; do not heat plastics beyond intended use.
caution: No replacing all plastic; no infant formula preparation changes, no glass breakage risk.

action: Wash under running water, eat diverse fruits and vegetables, organic optional if affordable.
caution: No soap or chemical washing solutions on produce; organic not pesticide-free.

action: Simplify product routines; choose fragrance-free when practical and tolerated; no broad product bans.
caution: Adolescent biomarker evidence indirect; fragrance-free not proof of overall safety; do not stop indicated treatments.

action: Fix leaks and moisture, clean safely, maintain CO alarms and test radon when appropriate.
caution: Never mix cleaners; alarm or suspected CO exposure exit and emergency response; no home mold toxin diagnosis.

action: Investigate known water contamination first; verify certification for exact filter model and maintain it.
cost: Cost depends on source and test results
caution: No routine blood test, donation or detox recommendation; no automatic breastfeeding cessation.
